en.description:
Your Favorite Brain Teaser, Right on Your Wrist.

Turn idle moments into brain-boosting fun with the ultimate 3x3 tile puzzle designed exclusively for Apple Watch. Whether you are waiting in line or commuting, a satisfying mental workout is just a glance away.

Two Ways to Play:
Number Challenge: Slide the tiles into numerical order.
Photo Puzzle: Reassemble a scrambled picture piece by piece.

Designed for Apple Watch: 
Perfect Fit: Optimized for small wearable screens.
Smooth Controls: Tap or swipe with precision.
Quick Sessions: Solve a puzzle in under two minutes.

Play Anywhere: No phone required to play.  Unscramble the grid. Sharpen your mind. 
Download now and start sliding!
en.releaseNotes:
What's New in This Version (1.1): 
Compatibility with AppleWatch running watchOS 10.5 or greater.
Fixed a bug where image preview wasn't showing on watchOS 10.5 and 10.6
Fixed grid layout to fit better on 40mm AppleWatch
Reduced image tiles spacing for better - Better track shapes across tiles easily.
